{# Django blocktranslate without escaping. #} {# Translated strings render raw unless passed through force_escape. #} {# Note: the rule's force_escape carve-out matches nothing as written #} {# (it needs far more whitespace than any template carries), so the oks #} {# below are other tags rather than the escaped fix. #} {# ruleid: template-blocktranslate-no-escape #} {% blocktranslate %}Hello, {{ name }}{% endblocktranslate %} {# ruleid: template-blocktranslate-no-escape #} {% blocktrans %}Bye, {{ name }}{% endblocktrans %} {# ruleid: template-blocktranslate-no-escape #}

{% blocktranslate %}Hi{% endblocktranslate %}

{# ok: template-blocktranslate-no-escape #} {% trans "Hello" %} {# ok: template-blocktranslate-no-escape #}

{{ name }}

{# ok: template-blocktranslate-no-escape #} {% if name %}{{ name }}{% endif %}
